Name: BFDI Merch for DGA
Author: ChibiMangoFlooferz
Description:
This mod currently adds a set of plushies of Firey from BFDI, using DGA! 
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Once you've installed the mod, the plushes will be available at the carpenter shop or in the catalogue! There are currently 5 variants of Firey: Jumbo, Jumbo (alternate), Bootleg Jumbo, Bootleg, and Regular.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[/list]
